d: The Sandpaper scandal may have happened in 2018, but Australian cricket is still dealing with its consequences. Cameron Bancroft's 4,500-word account has again opened questions about the ball-tampering scandal involving Steve Smith, David Warner and the Australian team, and who really took responsibility when things went wrong. With Pat Cummins now leading the Australia Test team, that claims to have moved on from that culture, has Bancroft's account put Australia's much-publicised reset under pressure? Rupha Ramani looks at what this latest chapter tells us about Australian cricket,…
